mechanism: Only the bmmBeforeDirectRows predicate changes from `n ≤ 4 ∨ p ≤ 2` to `n ≤ 4 ∨ p ≤ 8`; shapes with n>4 and 3<=p<=8 use DirectSmall instead of Packed10. No other runtime bytes change.
hypothesis: Packed10 pads every row to 10 lanes, so p=3 wastes about 70% of its lane work; the direct scalar core may win for short p even though it re-reads A.
proof: No new proof obligation: each edited `if` keeps both branches and their existing spec theorems; only the decidable predicate changes.

edits.old: if n ≤ 4 ∨ p ≤ 2 then DirectSmall.core batch m n p A B
edits.new: if n ≤ 4 ∨ p ≤ 8 then DirectSmall.core batch m n p A B
